name: Hisao Nakai
source: Having forged strong bonds of love and friendship in Yamaku, Hisao wants to live life to the fullest once again. With a romantic relationship to look forward to, and newfound resolve to overcome the limits imposed by his disability, Hisao takes his first steps towards securing a future for [url=https://vndb.org/c149229]Hanako[/url] and himself.
